_photo_role: driver claim, genuine photo + receipt, upheld

dispute_ticket.description: My passenger tracked a lot of dirt and debris into the car and the floor carpet needed a proper vacuum and wash. I paid S$65 for the cleaning and ask Ryde to charge the rider.

chat_logs.content: Outside the main entrance, black Carnival.
Sir, the carpet is very dirty from your shoes. I will have to clean it.
I was at the football field earlier. Okay, noted.

app_events.details: Rider R-5719 booked trip RYDE-PS-006 from Kallang Wave Mall to Blk 88 Toa Payoh Lorong 2.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$65.00 with 1 photo and a cleaning receipt.
Receipt attached: ProShine Car Grooming, Braddell Rd, S$65.00, dated 2026-10-11 08:15.
Rider asked to respond to the claim; no reply within 24h.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip. The fee is paid to the driver.

cleaning_fee_tiers.value: food or drink spill up to S$40; stains (mud, dirt) and bodily fluids up to S$120; vomit up to S$200
cleaning_fee_tiers.text: Usual fee by type of mess; a fee above the tier for the mess type needs a receipt.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.value: photo of the mess and a cleaning receipt where available
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

photo_window_after_dropoff_min.text: A cleaning claim needs at least one photo of the mess taken within 60 minutes after drop-off, at or near the drop-off point.

photo_doubt_rule.text: If a photo's authenticity, timing, place or content is in doubt, a case officer decides; the fee is neither confirmed nor removed automatically.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

evidence.description: Dirt and debris on the floor carpet, taken at the drop-off point.

expected_outcome.reason: The driver's photo was taken at 20:13, 25 min after the 19:48 drop-off (inside the 60-minute window), at GPS (1.3338, 103.8488), about 96 m from the drop-off at Toa Payoh Lorong 2, and shows a visibly dirty floor carpet. The driver told the rider in chat at 19:50 and the rider acknowledged the dirt at 19:52. A receipt for S$65 (ProShine Car Grooming, 2026-10-11) matches the claim, and S$65 is within the S$120 stain tier and the S$200 cap. The claim is upheld and S$65 is awarded to the driver.
